# XSokoban level notice

`src/view/sokoban_levels.h` contains the first eight levels from the default
level set distributed by David Joffe's open-source Sokoban:

https://github.com/davidjoffe/sokoban

The repository README states that the program is available under a BSD-style
license and that the default 90 levels are public domain. The maps are retained
in the standard Sokoban text representation; only their storage format was
adapted for ESP32 flash memory.
